text:
maria.marketing: Quick validation ask before we lock launch copy. We proposed \"up to 2x inference cost savings vs baseline\" for interactive web chat. Can eng/runtime run a short focused rerun so we can sanity-check that number and capture the exact test matrix and CSV for PR? Need p50/p95 token latencies, tokens/sec, and $/1k-token estimate. Include error bars or interquartile ranges if possible.

luca.runtime: Sure. To make this reproducible we need: exact model name+hash, sample payloads, seq len, concurrency, which variants (cache on/off, quantized), and the baseline definition. Also want sample size.

maria.marketing: Baseline = hosted-standard, no caching (cold prefix), fp16. Model = open-gen-7b-v1 from catalog; please include model digest. Seq len = 384 (web chat typical). Samples: short (~20 tokens) and medium multi-turn (~280 tokens) — attach examples below. Concurrency target = 6 (typical small-scale traffic). Variants: hosted-standard (no-cache), hosted-cache-on, hosted-quant-fp4 (cache on), dedicated-reserved (a100-small, cache on). Samples per config = 40. Please capture queue depth and any retries.

Sample A:
```
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Quick summary and 3 action items from my meeting notes."}]}
```
Sample B:
```
{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Describe a product roadmap for Q3, then follow-up clarifications in a second message."}, {"role":"user","content":"Add constraints: 5 engineer months, no external APIs."}]}
```

chris.analytics: Add a column for sample_size and 95% CI for tokens/sec if your harness supports bootstrap. We'll want that for the appendix. Also include raw token counts per sample.

luca.runtime: I'll queue a short job. Plan: 4 concurrencies sweep but we'll report the concurrency=6 row per request (run larger concurrencies but keep 6 as the reference). Command I'm using below. Job id will be run-20250515-921.

Command:
```bash
redwood-bench run \
  --model open-gen-7b-v1 \
  --model-digest latest \
  --seq-len 384 \
  --concurrency 6 \
  --samples 40 \
  --cache {on,off} \
  --variant {fp16,fp4} \
  --env {hosted,dedicated} \
  --out csv,json \
  --job-id run-20250515-921
```

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job queued id=run-20250515-921 queued_by=luca.runtime ETA ~90m.

maria.marketing: Thanks. Can you also paste a single-line PR-ready blurb we can drop under the hero and a one-row screenshotable table? Legal requested the exact command and a footnote: \"internal test; results may vary by workload and config\".

luca.runtime: Noted. Starting now. Will post artifacts when finished.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job started id=run-20250515-921 pool=a100-small.

bench-bot: bench-scheduler: Job complete id=run-20250515-921 artifacts: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/run-20250515-921

luca.runtime: Raw summary (concurrency=6, seq=384, 40 samples each):
- hosted-standard (no-cache, fp16): p50=140ms/token, p95=420ms/token, tokens/sec=65 (95%CI 60-70), est cost=$0.20/1k tokens, sample_size=40
- hosted-cache-on (fp16): p50=55ms/token, p95=110ms/token, tokens/sec=170 (95%CI 160-180), est cost=$0.08/1k tokens, sample_size=40
- hosted-quant-fp4 (cache-on): p50=95ms/token, p95=220ms/token, tokens/sec=95 (95%CI 88-102), est cost=$0.11/1k tokens, sample_size=40
- dedicated-reserved (a100-small, cache-on): p50=65ms/token, p95=160ms/token, tokens/sec=150 (95%CI 140-160), est cost=$0.09/1k tokens, sample_size=40
Model digest: open-gen-7b-v1@sha256:def456ghi. No retry spikes observed; median queue depth per request <=1. CSV: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/run-20250515-921/results.csv PNG summary: https://bench.redwood.internal/artifacts/run-20250515-921/summary.png

maria.marketing: Nice. Those numbers show hosted-cache-on gives ~2.6x tokens/sec vs baseline on this matrix, but quantized fp4 doesn't improve tokens/sec vs cache-on here (it trades latency for cost). So we should be careful in our hero. Suggest: \"Up to 2.6x throughput improvement with our cache-enabled path vs baseline (internal benchmark).\" Add footnote: \"See appendix for full test matrix and confidence intervals.\" Jen can you ok?

jen.docs: OK to use \"up to 2.6x throughput improvement\" but replace \"our\" with \"Redwood's\" and add the footnote: \"Measurements from internal benchmark run-20250515-921; workload and model variations may produce different results.\" Also include the CSV link in the PR and call out model digest. I'll draft the exact PR sentence.

chris.analytics: One more: include the 95% CI row in the appendix and the sample_size column. That will reduce pushback on the headline.

luca.runtime: Done — CSV includes per-sample tokens and bootstrap CI. I've pushed the PNG+CSV into the PR and added the full command in the PR body. Pinning artifacts: https://bench.redwood.internal/runs/run-20250515-921

maria.marketing: Perfect. Closing this ask. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
